pages.title: IRON NEST Mutators Database - 16 Variants, 10 Names
pages.description: Review 16 mutator configurations under 10 labels, including six same-name variants that change bearing and distance corrections without false deduplication.
pages.source_unique_value_statement: 在单页保留10个唯一显示名下的16组“名称+描述+tier”配置，尤其并列呈现六组同名但分别影响方向与距离修正的变体，避免错误去重。
